params.name: fullText
params.description: When `true`, only an exact full-name match is returned.

params.name: fields
params.description: Comma-separated list of fields to return on each country. Up to 10 fields may be requested. Required on `/all`.

items.docs: Search countries by common or official name. Partial, case-insensitive substring matches are returned by default. Set `fullText=true` to require an exact full-name match.
